morpho.note: Morpho explicitly featured on the dashboard (managed-vault curator tracking)

lido.note: Lido-related vaults monitored; /api/vaults?protocol=lido returns 5 vaults (e.g. Lido EarnETH, Lido EarnUSD) via the Turtle API datasource
